title: The missing stylesheet warning fires on a MarkdownViewer that needs no stylesheet
foundBy: consumer report on three applications pinned to 0.2.1-dev, verified against 0c015ef

evidence.verified: `components/MarkdownViewer.md` now says inline mode still needs `styles/components/markdown-viewer.css`, and why. `npm run check` exits 0 at 0c41ee9.

details:
`MarkdownViewer` in `inline` mode gives its root `data-component="MarkdownViewer"` and no `cs-component-` class, at `src/components/MarkdownViewer.tsx:783`. The presence marker is keyed on the attribute rather than on any class, so the check runs on that root and reports a missing sheet the root does not use.

A consumer rendering `<MarkdownViewer content={...} inline />` with `markdown-content.css` and `syntax.css` loaded, and `markdown-viewer.css` deliberately not, gets a warning naming a sheet they were right to leave out.

A warning that fires on a correct configuration is worse than no warning, because it teaches a reader to ignore the next one. That undoes what the check was built for.

One thing to settle when fixing it. The outline and minimap chrome is gated on the `outline` prop rather than on `inline`, so a consumer passing both does render elements that need the sheet. Whether the skip belongs on `inline` alone needs measuring rather than assuming.

notes.text:
This record's own details are wrong, and the measurement is the useful part. Inline mode does not need "no stylesheet": the scroller carries `cs-component-markdown-viewer-156` at `MarkdownViewer.tsx:855`, and that class has a rule, `min-width: 0`, which is what lets the content shrink inside a flex row. So the warning the consumer reported as a false positive was correct, and their import set was incomplete.

Documented rather than changed. Changing the component on a premise that does not hold would have removed a rule that matters to anyone embedding the viewer in a flex row.

The caveat this record raised also turned out to be unnecessary. `inline` suppresses outline and minimap unconditionally at `MarkdownViewer.tsx:270`, so the two cannot coexist and there was no combination to measure.
